bagPolicy.summary: One A4-size bag or standard handbag per person may enter; backpacks, laptop bags, travel cases and large totes are prohibited. Bags are checked at entry.
allowed: One A4-size bag or standard handbag
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: On-site concert parking is reserved for approved Blue Badge applications; both the event parking pass and Blue Badge must be displayed.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The current stadium security and concert access pages do not designate a rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Stadium food and drink stands take cashless card and contactless payment; outside food and drink must be finished before entry.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible platform and ambulant seating use step-free entrances; standing tickets require about 55 steps and do not have accessible entry. Pre-approved Blue Badge parking needs an event pass.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The venue’s published concert guide says tickets scan only once, so leaving prevents re-entry; check the current show’s guide for changes.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Hampden does not sell concert tickets and directs ticket issues to the SEC or the original seller; no universal Will Call pickup process is published.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Follow the entrance on the ticket and have it ready for scanning; current security guidance asks guests to keep bags and coats on their person during screening.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
